units: SI: sq/sh kg/s, pu kg*m^2/s, arms m; omega rad/s
sign_convention: force/torque on particles = - derivative of positive half-dissipation

scalar_sources.equations: Forces_Torques.tex section 6 A/B/C functions; section 4 compares Ball-Melrose and incorrect lubricate/poly coupling

Ball_Melrose.access: author repository abstract and frozen upstream displayed dissipation; publisher full text HTTP403, repository states full output unavailable
Ball_Melrose.not_claimed: Full original paper was not accessible/read

normal_mode: JO XA singular 1/xi and log plus xi log terms, excludes O(1) far-field constants
shear_mode: JO YA log plus xi log terms; same scalar as stable
pump_mode: Schur complement C11-B11^2/YA_leading of independent transverse matrix; correct unequal-sphere coupled block
finite_gap_completion: Project-defined frame-invariant near-field completion. Actual r torque arms; pu multiplied (r/(a+b))^2. Retains stable positive sq/sh scalars. Agrees with published singular transverse block at h->0; not full finite-separation Stokes resistance. No fitting. Exact zero pair force/torque on rigid collective motion.
twist_mode: PENDING_BLOCKER: upstream absent; nonsingular XC contains collective drag and far-field constants; unique relative-mode matching to retained isolated Stokes drag not validated
background: q0=[Uinf,Omega_inf]; bpair=Rpair*q0-Bslip.T*D*(a+b)*Ebar*n; Ebar=(Ei+Ej)/2. Same leading strain convention as stable, explicit local-affine closure for arbitrary frozen field.

regularization.purpose: numerical finite resistance before independent hard contact; not measured roughness or elastic shell
regularization.cutoff: sharp, identical before all convergence candidates

C_gap_rule: dt <= Cgap*max(h,h_min)/max(abs(relative normal speed),1e-30), additionally Cadv and physical end time; hard constraints applied to RK2 midpoint and full displacement relative to step-start normal
